Four delays. You judge the feel.

Each attempt streams through the frozen Verified Tracker exactly as it would live. The birds fly the interpreted contour — corridor-bounded, third-tone staged — at the delay you pick. Dots show certified frames (the honest evidence).

preparing tracker…

What to feel for: does she move when you moved, a breath behind? Does the third tone still read as a dip when your voice went creaky at the bottom? Does 80 ms buy liveliness or just nerves? The winning delay is the one that stays honest and calm.
